decision_source: user requested a broader overnight portfolio informed by papers from different angles; method choices proposed by assistant
problem: Optical available: retain useful DSM fusion, control negative transfer under DSM quality changes, and support DSM missing inference
hardware: two H100 80GB; RAM and disk adequate as explicitly confirmed by user
launch: nohup controller, stdin /dev/null, all snapshots/logs/checkpoints/temporary files within this experiment directory; no /tmp
existing_queue: D23 complete; do not recover/restart it
implementation_required: presence-masked M0 continuation with last-four-block gradient path
detached dual-GPU queue with safe exact resume and direct light-record upload

data.input: RGB plus existing per-tile normalized DSM
data.held4_policy: not loaded this round; historical Train16 checkpoint exposure means not an independent holdout
data.sampling: uniform tile then uniform aligned random crop; reuse canonical D23 sample RNG, horizontal/vertical flip; augment decisions keyed independently by crop/step

training.loss_normalization: 0.5 * CE(clean) + 0.5 * CE(augmented); identical views within each objective comparison
training.precision: bf16 autocast, FP32 loss/optimizer; all new arms share policy
training.selection: best clean Val2 NoBoundary pooled fg5; ties choose earlier step; no test
training.frozen_scope: A0/A1 DINO frozen; rgb/detail/decoder trainable. A2/A3/B/D/C last4 blocks plus route head trainable; encoder norm and early blocks frozen; teachers all frozen

Q.definitions: reuse D23 exact condition implementation; one quality condition per augmented crop

D.mask: known availability mask, never inferred from auxiliary tensor being numerically zero

augmentation.QD: Q then D; independent canonical draws
augmentation.C: student sees Q optical component only; fixed teacher sees same Q optical/DSM view with DSM available, no D

pair.granularity: mean CE of each clean crop over valid label pixels
pair.reason: fixed optical comparator avoids improving the ranking merely by worsening the fewer-modality branch

prototype.update: training clean view only, detached features, fit12 labels only for semantic assignment; freeze bank for validation/inference
prototype.generic_assignment: deterministic uniform spatial hash into six buckets; no class labels
prototype.common_architecture: RGB and DSM 128ch stride4 features; concatenate query/bank pairs; q/k 256->32, v 256->128; six-slot attention; zero-initialized 128->128 residual projection before decoder; both DSM contribution and prototype residual multiplied by known presence mask
prototype.empty_bank: initialized to same global clean fit-feature mean; EMA only where support exists
prototype.capacity: same parameter shapes/count and initial state across B0-B3; bank assignment and CE reduction are the two factors
prototype.class_balanced_CE: average per-class CE over classes present in valid batch pixels, all six training classes; no crop resampling

KD.formula: T^2 * KL(p_teacher || p_student), average over selected valid pixels, then average the two views
KD.teacher: fixed M0_safe on the corresponding clean/Q view; student optical only
KD.benefit_region: teacher argmax equals training label and fixed R0 argmax differs from label
KD.shuffle: circular shift benefit mask by floor(H/2),floor(W/3) on valid interior, using cyclic permutation of valid pixel coordinates to preserve exact selected count
KD.empty_region: zero KD, record count; no fallback to global KD

evaluation.diagnostic: Full fg5 and Full/NoBoundary six-class metrics
evaluation.stitch: uniform FP32 logits; same native coordinate alignment as D23
evaluation.precision: FP32 with existing TF32 policy; one complete 14-condition evaluation for each selected checkpoint
evaluation.composite: mean(clean, mean(four RGB conditions), mean(aux_down4,aux_noise_std010)) in percentage points; same D23 definition
evaluation.harm_rescue: fixed R0 reference for cross-arm comparison, plus each new fusion model's own DSM-absent branch for within-model modality attribution; do not conflate the two
evaluation.C_primary: clean optical-only fg5 versus C0; report RGB-family robustness; do not claim zero DSM sensitivity is learned robustness
evaluation.raw_records: int64 6x6 matrices, per-class TP/FP/FN/support, per-tile and condition counts, harm/rescue and availability counts, config/source/input/checkpoint SHA

screen.evidence_level: single_seed_development_screen; no p values or confirmation

negative_transfer_claim.reference: fixed R0 counts against matched CE/capacity control on nine available conditions; no absolute old D23 gate carried over

screen.strong_historical_reference: M0_safe; history is not the sole matched comparator
screen.failed_current_candidate: close that hypothesis at this budget, no automatic LR/lambda sweep or extra seeds
screen.passing_candidate: at most two hypotheses for separately planned seed17/2026 and unseen/independent validation; not automatically launched

runtime.ETA: derived from ordinary first completed jobs by route, no separate capacity or budget probe; no completion time promised before new graph runs
runtime.deadline_policy: no promise all15 complete by morning; continue existing queue with bounded jobs, record timeout as technical failure not scientific negative
runtime.failure_policy: retain failure and continue other jobs; no automatic repeat; exact resume only from bound checkpoint/RNG
runtime.progress: every 60s persist state, phase, step, elapsed/ETA, last log timestamp; route-dependent train/eval timings
runtime.forbidden: changing effective batch/steps/precision based on intermediate science results, duplicate D23, use Test6, files outside zzx
